g.text: Matched monitor diagnostics with method-specific scales

text.style: font-size: 7px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', 'Bitstream Vera Sans', 'Computer Modern Sans Serif', 'Lucida Grande', 'Verdana', 'Geneva', 'Lucid', 'Arial', 'Helvetica', 'Avant Garde', sans-serif; text-anchor: middle

g.text: Five T-MAE seed points for a row are repeated checkpoint fits on the same exposed supports, not additional rows or independent lakes/events. RPCA outputs are retained from a NONCONVERGED_MAX_ITERATIONS fit. Method units are not comparable.
